credentials_mcp_client_check.name: credentials_mcp_client_check
credentials_mcp_client_check.value: ("credentials"."kind" = 'mcp') = ("credentials"."client" IS NOT NULL) AND ("credentials"."challenge" IS NULL OR "credentials"."kind" = 'mcp')

device_logins_approval_names_principal.name: device_logins_approval_names_principal
device_logins_approval_names_principal.value:
("device_logins"."decision" IS NULL AND "device_logins"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "device_logins"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_logins"."generation" = 0 AND "device_logins"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("device_logins"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "device_logins"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND (
          ("device_logins"."decision" = 'denied' AND "device_logins"."principal" IS NULL AND "device_logins"."generation" = 0 AND "device_logins"."consumed_at" IS NULL)
          OR ("device_logins"."decision" = 'approved' AND "device_logins"."principal" IS NOT NULL AND "device_logins"."principal" LIKE 'user:%')
        ))

environments_owner_check.name: environments_owner_check
environments_owner_check.value: "environments"."owner" IS NULL OR ("environments"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "environments"."owner" LIKE 'user:_%')

generated.as: CASE WHEN revoked_at IS NULL THEN subject END

projects_folder_check.name: projects_folder_check
projects_folder_check.value: "projects"."folder" IS NULL OR (char_length("projects"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "projects"."folder" !~ '[/[:cntrl:]]' AND "projects"."folder" = btrim("projects"."folder"))

secrets_source_check.name: secrets_source_check
secrets_source_check.value: "secrets"."source_id" IS NULL OR ("secrets"."source_id" <> "secrets"."id" AND "secrets"."current_version" IS NULL)

secrets_nature_check.name: secrets_nature_check
secrets_nature_check.value: ("secrets"."nature" IS NULL) = ("secrets"."current_version" IS NULL) AND ("secrets"."nature" IS NULL OR "secrets"."nature" IN ('plain', 'secret', 'sensitive'))

secrets_recipe_check.name: secrets_recipe_check
secrets_recipe_check.value: ("secrets"."recipe" IS NULL AND "secrets"."pair_id" IS NULL) OR "secrets"."current_version" IS NOT NULL

secrets_pair_check.name: secrets_pair_check
secrets_pair_check.value: ("secrets"."pair_id" IS NULL) = ("secrets"."pair_half" IS NULL) AND ("secrets"."pair_half" IS NULL OR "secrets"."pair_half" IN ('private', 'public'))

secrets_folder_check.name: secrets_folder_check
secrets_folder_check.value: "secrets"."folder" IS NULL OR (char_length("secrets"."folder") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "secrets"."folder" !~ '[/[:cntrl:]]' AND "secrets"."folder" = btrim("secrets"."folder"))
